headline.text: All three plants shut down clean for the long weekend with *6 items* flagged for Monday follow-up and no line-down events in the 24 hours.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 completed kitchen shutdowns across Sollich 1, 2, and 4 with no production incidents. A few cleaning areas were flagged and re-worked before close. Materials planning flagged low inventory on two ingredients ahead of next week's schedule.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 stopped depositing at 17:15 and ran level 2 cleans on ML2, ML3, and FFS. ML2 cleared a drive roller bearing issue. ML3 cleaned up a 120-pound chocolate spill at the sweco during shift change but two ingredient tank issues remain open.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ran production through second shift, then executed level 2 cleans on ML1, ML4, and MF Matrix. A shipping miscommunication was resolved by staging product for Saturday. ML1 had roller cleaning concerns that cleared by final inspection, but a few operational flags remain for Monday.

notes.text: Thanksgiving greetings posted by Curt Willis at 08:47.
Zack Kurtz posted 5S reminder to keep checkweigher clearance zone free of bins to prevent inaccurate weight readings.
Second shift completed depositor assembly installation on ML1 before close.

resolved.title: Sollich 4 D1 caustic process not recorded on level 2 paperwork
resolved.summary: Third shift completed caustic wash on D1 but did not log it on level 2 documentation, raising traceability concern.
resolved.resolution: Charity Young confirmed documentation requirement at 07:38, Luis Falcon completed and recorded the work by 07:40.

resolved.title: Sollich 1 metal detector belt, top matrix floor, and tunnels 1 & 2 cleaning failures
resolved.summary: Pre-inspection flagged multiple areas needing re-clean before holiday shutdown.
resolved.resolution: Joseph Scott dispatched sanitation team at 06:53, posted completion photos by 07:50.

resolved.title: ML3 sweco chocolate overflow at shift change
resolved.summary: Operators walked into filler room at shift change and found chocolate flowing down the sweco.
resolved.resolution: 120 pounds of chocolate lost, sweco cleaned, tested at 06:48 with no issues observed (Gustavo Rodas). Flagged to retest Monday morning before tempering.

resolved.title: ML2 drive roller belt rubbing due to loose bearing housing
resolved.summary: Bearing and housing came loose causing belt contact during 5-belt changeout.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance tightened housing with 1/8 inch gap, line ran smooth with no concerns for Monday per Zack Kurtz at 22:31.

resolved.title: ML4 mold washer failed visual with screws found inside
resolved.summary: Pre-operational inspection found screws inside mold washer and failed cleanliness check.
resolved.resolution: Re-cleaned and passed visual inspection and ATP at 05:03 (Janeth Sanchez).

resolved.title: ML4 chiller technician needed lockout lock
resolved.summary: Contractor working on chiller over the holiday needed LOTO hardware.
resolved.resolution: Spencer Andrus confirmed at 18:28 tech has spare lock marked 'A' from maintenance shop, will return Monday.

resolved.title: MF Matrix paused for box shortage
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 20:11 due to lack of corrugate boxes.
resolved.resolution: Production resumed; lot and BB date change approved at 20:12, level 2 clean completed by 04:48.

resolved.title: ML1 C6 conveyor roller not fully cleaned
resolved.summary: Visual inspection failed on C6 belt because rollers were not disassembled for full cleaning, leaving chocolate residue.
resolved.resolution: Belts pulled and re-cleaned; final level 2 cleaning passed visual and ATP at 05:13 (Janeth Sanchez).

resolved.title: Springville transfer load missed cutoff due to miscommunication
resolved.summary: Full trailer of 30703 and 30944 ready to ship, but Springville cutoff already passed despite earlier confirmation that transfers could be sent.
resolved.resolution: Trailer unloaded and staged by docks per German Cervantes at 23:37; 30703 ships Saturday, remaining items Monday morning.

needs_attention.title: Low inventory on Bequet flow wrap and tapioca ahead of Tuesday run
needs_attention.summary: Flow wrap of Bequet (41273) down to last 1.5 pallets and tapioca (10267) down to last 3 pallets, both scheduled for production Tuesday.
needs_attention.status: Posted at 02:58 with no inbound confirmation in the window; needs materials planning follow-up before Tuesday.

needs_attention.title: ML3 ingredient tank visual inspection failed with peppermint residue
needs_attention.summary: Victor Mejia and Marlenis Fernandez found peppermint in the center of the ingredient tank during pre-shift inspection.
needs_attention.status: Failed visual at 22:21, no re-clean or clearance posted by end of window.

needs_attention.title: ML2 ingredient tank #1 leak
needs_attention.summary: Leak observed on ingredient tank #1 during third shift.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 22:46 with note that maintenance would take a look; no update posted by shutdown.

needs_attention.title: Twist wrap pallet received with mixed expiration dates
needs_attention.summary: Pallet of twist wraps from other building has mixed BB dates with no way to identify changeover point, impacting traceability.
needs_attention.status: Posted at 04:19 with recommendation to contact supplier building; no resolution or corrective action confirmed.

needs_attention.title: ML1 glycol low
needs_attention.summary: Glycol level low on ML1 during second shift production.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 18:30, no refill or maintenance response posted by end of shift.

needs_attention.title: Unlocked door found during holiday walk-around
needs_attention.summary: Tyson Fausett found an unlocked door during pre-holiday facility check.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 07:55 with photo; no confirmation of lock status or root cause posted.
